**SOE / Endpoint Administrator, Theo Nowak -** Theo is the hands-on person who actually builds and runs Tessera's Standard Operating Environment. He bakes the endpoint images, sets Office and macro policy, applies the browser and application hardening, and pushes patches out to the fleet across Perth, Sydney and the Malaga ops centre. He reports to Hamish Boyd and speaks to the messy operating reality that management-level policy tends to gloss over: where the running config drifts from the standard, where carve-outs quietly become permanent, and where the legacy Malaga footprint makes "good" expensive. He is candid, practical, and clear that a control being documented is not the same as it being enforced.

**Interview Focus: SOE / Endpoint Administrator Theo Nowak**
Students should press Theo on the endpoint pillars of the Essential Eight and the gap between policy and practice. Useful questions: whether Office macros are genuinely blocked, or whether Finance's legacy spreadsheet templates still run with them enabled and whether that exception was ever formally approved; whether the application-hardening baseline is actually enforced by GPO across the whole fleet or just documented, and how laptops and browser extensions drift; and how patching really works on the Malaga legacy boxes, whether it lands inside the 14-day SLA, and whether anyone measures it cleanly. He will tell you where reality is messy, but he will not hand you the conclusion.
